name: Authentication Method Change
description: Authentication methods are the phone numbers, authenticator apps, and FIDO keys on an Entra user. Adding a method the attacker controls means they can pass MFA next time even if you reset the password. This is how a phishing kit turns a one-time code into lasting access. Users do add phones when they get a new device. Attackers add a second authenticator in the middle of the night from a new country. Method registration on privileged users from unusual locations is the high-value alert.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
